node.title: Re: Using Cartons to automate module installs
node.author: choroba
node.doctext:
> Q2) How do I know whether I have all the core modules? How do I not leave it to chance?

Why do you care? Name all the dependencies in your Makefile.PLs, or cpanfiles, including the core dependencies.

> Q4) What perl aliases do you use? What aliases in general?

I don't use aliases much, as they are less flexible than functions and scripts. You can find some of my tools I've carried around for years in [https://github.com/choroba/small-scripts|this GitHub repo]. Some of them are written in Perl ([https://github.com/choroba/small-scripts/blob/master/chjoin|chjoin], [https://github.com/choroba/small-scripts/blob/master/dups|dups], [https://github.com/choroba/small-scripts/blob/master/git-graphs|git-graphs]), some are Perl related ([https://github.com/choroba/small-scripts/blob/master/blead|bead], [https://github.com/choroba/small-scripts/blob/master/perl-etags.pl|perl-etags.pl]).
